notes.title: My Friendly Neighborhood Out Now On Consoles!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hiya! John here! [/h1][p]If you didn't know, I was the main guy behind My Friendly Neighborhood. In many ways, My Friendly Neighborhood has been a life-changing project. First of all, making My Friendly Neighborhood was one of the most educational experiences I will likely have in my professional life, both from a development side and a business side. Releasing My Friendly Neighborhood was one the most emotionally difficult experiences I've ever gone through. Figuring out what direction to take in my development after My Friendly Neighborhood was finished has been extremely difficult and confusing. The excitement of seeing a game played in front of millions of people, seeing sales charts, and reading reviews gets mixed into a pot with all the complicated aspects that come along with business, seeing aspects of your game you wished you had done differently, and wondering where on earth you're going to go in your professional life. It's a very emotionally confusing place to be.[/p][p][/p][p]But to be clear - all of the good things that have come from My Friendly Neighborhood, the relief of a game releasing to a joyful reception, the exciting moments and upcoming opportunities, the ability to now grow and continue my game development, was because of you. Having something you've spent a significant portion of your life making be embraced and appreciated by so many people is a deeply meaningful feeling that I don't have a good way of describing. Forgetting the money and the business, the plans, the strategies, and all that stuff that comes along with game development - I truly want to thank you for appreciating my game. Because after now two years, another game in development, and many many changes in my life, that's the thing I remember most strongly - that what I made meant something to you. I could happily leave the rest if I can keep that.[/p][p][/p][h1]Now, for some announcements:[/h1][p]It has been a very long journey to get here, but I am very happy to tell you that My Friendly Neighborhood console ports are launching RIGHT NOW for Xbox consoles (as well as Game Pass) and PlayStation 5, with  plans to target *some other platforms* a little bit later as well! Additionally, I've put together a small online store where you can purchase some official My Friendly Neighborhood merch! You can find it over at [url="https://shop.ducky.dev/"]https://shop.ducky.dev/[/url] if that's your kind of thing. I know so many people have been waiting for both console ports and the ability to get some official merch - I really apologize it's taken so long to get these things together, but sometimes things just end up being a lot more difficult than you expect. (Chalk that up to the "business learning experiences" I suppose!)[/p][p][/p][p]I don't know exactly where the years are going to take my development, but I'm so glad we can share a celebration for a game that meant so much to me and that you have loved so well. Here's to many more friendly years together![/p][p][/p][p]-John S.
[/p][h3]Changelog:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed interaction with the key after completing the kitchen puzzle in the Penthouse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing material on buildings seen through the windows in the Office level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text spacing when picking up an item while the inventory is full[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bullet Model Change cheat breaking the default bullet hit box[/p][/*][*][p]The Unlock menu no longer appears without completing the game[/p][/*][*][p]The “Default" settings option is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization for "New Speedrun" text[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing characters for various languages[/p][/*][*][p]Speedrun timer is now saved upon quitting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed UI overlaps[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing localization for "inventory full" in Japanese and Chinese Traditional[/p][/*][*][p]Overall performance and stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Various graphical tweaks and optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]More behind-the-scenes changes[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1069jM3bkO4;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Game Released! Exiled - Ancient Puzzle Thriller
notes.notes:
[h1]A New Game: Exiled[/h1]

Charlotte is missing. A note has been left on her desk talking of "the ancient evil" and "banishment to a different realm." The eldritch tome and an untranslated scrap she had been studying act as the only clues to her disappearance. Use clues found in the book to translate an ancient language, evade the lurking horrors, and solve the mystery of the strange objects around you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/a53b5dd1234596509197b2e5b6293695551e47d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/1aa662c879a1eb4fb48d6e8bd2bd070214875145.png[/img]

This is a compact, detailed puzzle thriller similar to The Room and Myst. The player can inspect items, use clues, and slowly crack the mystery of the Great Library.

[list]
[*]Solve ancient puzzles, decode an eldritch language, and avoid the lurking horror all while sitting at a single desk
[*]Tense and foreboding atmosphere where the stillness of the library can be shattered at any moment
[*]High level of interactivity
[*]Multiple endings
[*]Good for a single play session
[*]Voiceover by Tom Schalk
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/97c4a8cf83bd3f8ec00e5efe303c72e2878e24ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/ba1e6a65a44cab78a92941678c1efd7287e30764.png[/img]

notes.title: The Friendly Difficulty
notes.notes:
[h2]We wanted to remind you about some of MFN’s brand new features![/h2]

[h3]What is Friendly difficulty?[/h3]

This mode is designed for people who just want to experience the story or have an easy going and [i]Friendly[/i] time! Playing on the new [i]Friendly[/i] difficulty adds a whole suite of accessibility features. Changes to gameplay in this new difficulty include [b]how many hits enemies can take before going down[/b], [b]more frequent checkpoints[/b], [i]and most notably, [b]saving no longer requires tokens[/b][/i]!

notes.title: The Friendly Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
[h1][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h1]

[h2]Major:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new difficulty has been added to the game! The [b]Friendly[/b] difficulty eases back on some the challenging aspects of [i]My Friendly Neighborhood[/i], making it more approachable for our fans. On this difficulty, [i][b]saving no longer requires tokens, puppets take less shots to down, and checkpoints are more frequent[/b][/i]. You can select this new difficulty from the menu when you start a new game!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/c0dcf45dacc61d48935f3e20c203494fe862882b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Miscellaneous:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Save locations have been noted on the map with a [i]new icon[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41025656/ce4d4c15cff9e84375ad2ea2d21c079ecb201455.png[/img]
[*] Made it impossible to map escape over [i]"Action"[/i]
[*] Speedrun timer now only starts ticking [i]after[/i] difficulty is selected
[*] Adjusted some unfair enemy spawns
[*] Made the timings on the Greenhouse puzzle more generous
[*] Various fixes and changes based on feedback
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement errors for Static and Streamlined
[*] Fixed various OOB softlocks
[*] Fixed an issue where the rebinding screen would lock up.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Green Triangle key could be discarded before it was completed
[*] Fixed an issue where you can softlock by falling of a certain set of stairs sideways
[*] Fixed an issue where checkpoints would not trigger in the main Sound Stage
[*] Fixed an issue where toggling [i]Bullet Model Change[/i] on and off could cause weapons to not fire
[*] Fixed an issue where black bars would take up the side of the screen for 32:9 monitors
[*] Fixed issues relating to achievements unlocking from certain endings/cheats
[*] Fixed an error where firing the shotgun .3 seconds before going through a door could softlock you
[*] Fixed an error where the Aviary door would not always spawn its teleport location
[*] Fixed an issue where the Unlocks menu would sometimes appear as unlocked before it was actually unlocked
[/list]

[i](This also includes fixes from recent hot-fixes to the game.)[/i]

And as always, please post any issues you come across or feedback you may have in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1574260/discussions/0/6163789601643172201/]My Friendly Neighborhood Bugs and Feedback Thread[/url] or on the relevant channels on the [url=https://discord.gg/M9RvpAeH5s]DREADXP Discord[/url].
